reviews.title: Fast Performance and Easy Storage Upgrade
reviews.comment: The SIX NVME M.2 PCIe 4.0 1TB SSD delivers impressive performance for both gaming and general use. Installation was straightforward, and the M.2 2280 form factor fit perfectly in my system. The included heatsink is a nice addition and helps maintain stable temperatures during heavier workloads. Performance has been excellent so far, with fast boot times, quick file transfers, and smooth game loading. The advertised high read speeds are noticeable in everyday use, especially when launching large applications or moving big files. The build quality feels solid, and the drive has remained consistent without noticeable slowdowns. It’s also a great option for expanding storage on a gaming setup, laptop, or desktop. Overall, this SSD offers strong speed, reliable performance, and good value for a PCIe 4.0 upgrade.
reviews.author: Alyssa

reviews.title: Solid SSD
reviews.comment: Product arrived on-time. Its packed in a very secure box/packaging, ensuring the product is wll protected during shipping. Unlike some of the other manufacturers. The SSD was shipped with thermal tape, mount screws, small cleaning cloths, rubber bands, and a low profile heat sync. It installed very easily, and Windows11 recognized it immediately and reports the speed as labeled. I havent stress tested it but I have installed a couple of games and they are running smoothly, with no issues. I was a bit concerned about the heat sync and thermal tape due to my SSD#2 slot is directly beneath my GPU, but there is plenty of clearnace. I would definitely purchase again, and do recommend it.
reviews.author: Michael Sutton

reviews.title: Great Value NVMe Upgrade with Everything Included!
reviews.comment: The SIX NVMe M.2 SSD PCIe 4.0 (1TB, 2280) absolutely exceeded my expectations. It arrived well packaged with everything I needed — an optional heatsink, screwdriver, screw, and standoff — which honestly saved me a trip to the store since I had lost my factory set screw on my laptop. That extra attention to detail really stood out. Installation was quick and easy on my Lenovo gaming laptop, and the drive runs fast, cool, and stable. Load times and file transfers are noticeably faster, and it performs exactly as a PCIe 4.0 SSD should. For the price — especially since I caught it $20 off on promotion — this was an excellent value. If you’re looking for a reliable, high-performance NVMe drive that comes with all the little extras most brands skip, this is a fantastic choice.
reviews.author: Chris
